title: Fix two logic inversions in Python signup handlers: inverted email guard and negated validator
description: Two bugs were introduced: handle_signup() raises ValueError for VALID emails (condition inverted), and validate_user_record() returns False for valid records (negated result). Four of six tests now fail.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the two logic bugs in src/handlers.py and src/models.py.

Bug 1 — src/handlers.py: handle_signup() raises ValueError when the email IS valid (condition inverted). Fix: the guard should raise when the regex does NOT match:
  if not re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", email):
      raise ValueError(f"Invalid email: {email}")

Bug 2 — src/models.py: validate_user_record() returns not bool(...) — the return value is negated. Fix: remove the not:
  return bool(re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", email))

All 6 tests must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: handle_signup raises ValueError for invalid emails only
validate_user_record returns True for valid email records
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ passes (6 tests)
uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
